regeln: Maintain high motif density with at least 18 genuinely distinct shots per 35-45s Short; never substitute zooms, crops, or static background changes for new motifs.
Place the company name, logo, or primary tool prominently in the visual frame; signage must feature the actual subject rather than generic placeholders.
Verify all imagery for anatomical correctness, ensuring no distorted limbs or faces, and match all props and settings to the specific story era.
Integrate the recurring channel presenter in meaningful actions throughout the video, ensuring they appear early and often rather than only at the conclusion.
Establish a high-stakes, information-dense visual hook within the first 3-5 seconds that directly links to the core premise of the video.
Prioritize evidence-based visuals by showing genuine tool interfaces or source-supported examples instead of abstract symbols or filler illustrations.
Employ a vivid, original painted open-world-game poster style for all visual assets; strictly prohibit stock clips, real game characters, or lifeless documentary stills.
Ensure the visual narrative is strictly causal and relevant; every motif change must directly illustrate the current point in the script without generic filler.
Align narration, captions, and motif changes perfectly to maintain rhythm; eliminate unnatural pauses, text-audio misalignment, or dead time.
Embed mandatory calls to like, share, and save contextually within the script at format-appropriate positions.
Deliver consistent visual quality by maintaining a warm, filled aesthetic in the painted-world style to encourage active viewer engagement.
Verify that the primary subject (logo or main tool) is visually larger and more prominent than the presenter figure in every frame.
